thread:
Noah (sales): Urgent - enterprise POC hit repeated 5xx during a partner demo. They're worried this will derail the close. Demo in 90m. Need rapid triage. :sweat:
Rina (solutions): Which org/region and model? Any custom routing or private deploy?
Noah (sales): Org: partner-acme-9, hosted us-east-1, model: raven-13b-32k quantized. Traffic jump from ~15 -> 250 concurrent in ~4m.
Eli (eng-oncall): Likely autoscaler + burstpool + request fanout. Can you drop sample request ids and confirm if they used warmup?
Noah (sales): Sample ids: acme-req-501, acme-req-502. They did run parallel warmup and enabled SDK auto-retry.
Tess (support): Pulling logs now. Also check if client is re-sending on 5xx without jitter. That amplifies spikes.
Eli (eng-oncall): Log snippet:
[2026-03-21T20:03:20Z] ERROR backend: 503 capacity_throttle pool=burstpool-us-east active=248 cap=200
[2026-03-21T20:03:21Z] WARN autoscaler: cold_start=true scale_time=42s pending_gpus=4
[2026-03-21T20:03:22Z] INFO router: retry_loop_detected org=partner-acme-9 retries=2

Eli (eng-oncall): Root cause: burstpool cap reached and autoscaler cold-start ~40s. SDK retries created retry amplification.
Rina (solutions): Immediate mitigations we can do now? They need the demo to proceed with degraded UX if required.
Eli (eng-oncall): Options (short-term):
- Push routing fallback to raven-7b for latency >400ms.
- Apply temporary org-level throttle: max_concurrency=100 (returns 429 instead of 503).
- Temporary burstpool uplift + billing approval for overage.
- Ask client to disable warmup + set retries to 1 with jitter.
Tess (support): I can send a quick patch to their SDK config and a one-liner to disable warmup; they'll accept if we provide it now.
Noah (sales): Do the fallback and throttle. I'll ask customer to reduce concurrency while we add capacity.
Eli (eng-oncall): Applying routing override and throttle now:
# infra CLI
rictl routing apply --org partner-acme-9 --policy "fallback:{threshold_ms:400,fallback_model:raven-7b}"
rictl policy set --org partner-acme-9 --throttle "max_concurrency:100"

ops-bot: routing: applied for partner-acme-9 (10s) :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: policy:set: throttle applied (5s) :white_check_mark:
Tess (support): Sent SDK patch to customer: `setRetryPolicy({maxRetries:1,backoffMs:300,jitter:true}); disableWarmup();` They confirmed update and dropped concurrency to ~90.
Rina (solutions): Billing for uplift - can we temporarily bump burstpool by +50 and tag for Sales Ops reconciliation?
Eli (eng-oncall): I can request uplift but need approval. If Sales Ops approves, infra-bot can provision +50 for 1h.
Noah (sales): I'm pinging Sales Ops now. Customer ok with temporary overage if it keeps the demo live.
ops-bot: reserve: added 50 burstpool units for partner-acme-9 (ttl 1h) — pending billing flag.

Eli (eng-oncall): Monitoring. Early signal: after throttle + fallback errors dropped from 18/s to 0.6/s. Autoscaler finished warm-up and added GPUs ~45s after initial spike.
Tess (support): I'll attach timeline and logs to ticket ACME-POC-311 and prepare a 1-page incident note for the customer.
Rina (solutions): Postmortem / playbook items: require demo reservation for concurrency>75, recommend disabling warmup by default for demos, add SDK snippet in demo runbook, and add capacity_headroom alert for dedicated/burstpool < 20.
Noah (sales): Thank you team. I'll update the customer: summary + promise for follow-up one-pager and runbook changes.
ops-bot: monitor: alerts muted for partner-acme-9 until 3245009999
Eli (eng-oncall): Follow-up action: add an automated pre-demo check that verifies headroom and optionally pre-reserves capacity for flagged orgs.
Tess (support): Closing immediate thread — will append final metrics after 1h monitoring window.
